'''Lashia Traz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. After Empress [[Vaylin]] was killed during the [[Assault on Odessen]], the [[Eternal Fleet]] went rogue and began bombarding Zakuul, destroying Traz's home among many others. Lashia sent a holomessage to her father [[Dersin Traz|Dersin]] warning him to stay away from Zakuul, but her message was interrupted by a violent explosion in the area.<ref>{{TORcite|Chapter VIII: End Times}}</ref>
